{{Top|leg}}
'''The Festival'''<ref name="l">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> also known as the '''[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] Anniversary celebration''',<ref name="b">{{LivingForce|Blown Away}}</ref> was a four-day holiday that was celebrated with a party every year (1,424 standard days) in planet [[Genarius]] and certain cities of other planets in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

==Origin==
The Festival was initiated when [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], the biggest corporate interest in [[Edic Bar]], began the production of the [[G-59 Cannibalizer]], a snub fighter intended to compete with [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom's]] [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. After several problems with the development (including failed attempts at reverse engineering of the Z-95), the production line was completed and the first completed unit was finished and ready for sale.<ref name="l" />

At that point, the Director of Formal Activities for SoroSuub, [[Miim Te'Suub]], stopped the production and, following orders of higher echelons, gave a short speech to the workers to say that they had the rest of that day as free time. The confused, workaholic Sullustans reacted by partying in neighbor city of [[Tolea Biqua]]. They got carried away, spreading their binge to the Toleans and even to other cities, and the party continued for four days before they remembered they had jobs at SoroSuub.<ref name="l" />

The workers were so satisfied that they decided to repeat yearly the situation, taking four days in remembrance of the first produced Cannibalizer. The Festival, as it would become known, was soon extended to all the cities in Genarius, and even to some cities in neighboring planets.<ref name="l" />

Director Te'Suub was initially scared, but his bosses were satisfied as he had followed orders. Besides, SoroSuub could use the Festival, and the threat of removing it, to control unsatisfied workers.<ref name="l" />

==Further parties==
[[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|The Festival of]] [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] was shaken by different incidents. Firstly, a prototype ship had been stole from SoroSuub facilities by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]] or an associate of his. The ship was kept in the hangars of the ''[[Conkesta]]'', Nalvas's secret headquarters in a hidden location near the planetary core. Nalvas's enemies infiltrated the ''Conkesta'' and escaped in the prototype ship, crash-landing in Tolea Biqua coincidentially near some SoroSuube executives who recognized the ship and offered a reward for it.<ref name="itsc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref>

A radiation storm then swept over Tolea Biqua and knocked out the city's shields.<ref name="b" /> Former Jedi and scholar [[Dazen Mok]], who witnessed the event, later theorized that the storm could have been caused by the destruction of the ''Conkesta'', which had been built using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]<ref name="tons">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040408|text=Tales of Nub Saar}}</ref> Other damage threatened to sent the city plunging into the core far below. A number of heroes managed to avert this crash.<ref name="b" />

Finally, [[Miim Te'Suub]] of SoroSuub gave his annual speech, but the sudden appearance of a logo of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] overimposed made him angry. Te'Suub blamed [[Thurm Loogg]] of the Cartel, and the Jedi witnesses had to resolve the dispute.<ref name="b" />
